title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Peers Co., Ltd. announced on September 2, 2026, a revision to its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026. The annual dividend per share has been increased to 17 yen, comprising an interim dividend of 0 yen and a year-end dividend of 17 yen, compared with 16 yen in the prior fiscal year ending September 2025.

The company stated that it recognizes dividend-based shareholder returns as an important management objective alongside business growth through operational efficiency and aggressive investment. The company targets a dividend payout ratio of 30% or higher and has adopted progressive dividend increases as its fundamental policy to achieve medium to long-term sustainable dividend growth while maintaining a balance between business investment and shareholder returns. The current fiscal year's year-end dividend was determined to be 17 yen per share based on comprehensive consideration of business performance trends and financial conditions in accordance with this policy.
